title: Realized-covariance HAR vs shrinkage/EWMA for out-of-sample GMV portfolios

config.return_type: simple (arithmetic) returns throughout, so that w'r is the exact portfolio return and Cov(r) is the exact GMV input
config.demeaning: none — block RCov and the sample/LW benchmarks all use the non-demeaned second moment, which makes the benchmark exactly nested in the HAR information set

audit.rule: every estimator uses daily returns through info_end_day; weights are applied starting at apply_start_day
audit.forecast_negative_diagonal_note: Cholesky: a negative L_ii still yields a PD matrix but signals the linear model extrapolating the variance channel through zero. Matrix-log: negative diagonals are the NORM (log of a small variance), so this count carries no diagnostic meaning under 'logm'.

dm_test_on_squared_returns.note: canonical repo dm_test; tests SECOND MOMENT equality, not variance equality (means are not removed)

rule.WIN: point estimate lower than all three AND the Ledoit-Wolf comparison survives Holm at alpha=0.05
rule.MIXED: some comparison survives Holm in the model's favour but the WIN condition is not met
rule.TIE_NULL: no comparison survives Holm in either direction
rule.LOSE: some benchmark has significantly lower variance after Holm
